stock.description: Cosmo Lady (China) Holdings Company Limited functions as an investment holding firm primarily involved in the design, development, research, and distribution of branded intimate apparel goods across the People's Republic of China. Its diverse product portfolio encompasses bras, underwear, sleepwear, loungewear, and thermal clothing, alongside items such as leggings, tights, vests, hosiery, and fashion accessories. These products are marketed under various brand names, including Cosmo Lady, Cosmo Elegance, Cosmo Blossom, Cosmo Esquire, Secret of City Beauty, Freeday, Rubii, Ilsée, Ordifen, and Ordifen+. Beyond its core product offerings, the company also delivers services in logistics, warehousing, distribution, property management, brand management, corporate consulting, and computer technology. Consumers can purchase its products through a multi-channel strategy, utilizing company-owned stores, franchised outlets, shopping mall locations, and its robust e-commerce platform. The company was founded in 1998 and maintains its headquarters in Dongguan, China.
